For Agencies

From awareness to prescription to fill to refill - understand every intent, improve every outcome.

Schedule a demo
0+EHR & Health System integrations
0+medical publishers
0+pharmacies

Doceree is the only healthcare marketing platform that can measure and adapt to the actual clinical intent of both physicians and patients. Built on the industry's largest real-time clinical signal network, Doceree's infrastructure unifies the entire healthcare journey - from physician awareness to prescription and patient fill to refill.

Prescriber + patient · one synchronized arc

01

Awareness

Build conviction with the prescriber, condition awareness with the patient.

02

First fill

From script written to the patient picking it up - where most prescriptions die.

03

Refill

Adherence, switch defense, every refill after.

The Reality

Pharma marketing got better at awareness. But patients keep abandoning therapy.

“Did it move prescriptions?”

It’s the only question the client asks now. You can show reach, frequency, and a beautiful omnichannel plan - but the honest answer still stops at the impression.

  1. Refill1 in 2

    chronic-disease patients stop their medication within a year.

    Therapy abandoned before it works
  2. First fill1 in 3

    new prescriptions never get filled at the pharmacy counter.

    Lost between the script and the shelf
  3. Legacy media20 yrs

    of media optimized for reach & impressions - stand-ins for the one outcome they could never connect to: the script that gets filled.

    Measured everything except the outcome

The Unlock

Sync. Two audiences, one motion.

Until now, every journey was built for the HCP or the patient, never both. Doceree keeps both sides in sync on one identity spine, so the physician’s message and the patient’s support move toward the same fill and refill.

Fill & Refill

Both sides converge on the one outcome that matters

The only platform that syncs prescriber and patient, from awareness to first fill and every refill.

How both sides stay compliant

De-identified, consent-based audiences - never PHI - linked at the segment level, not the individual record. Full detail under Built for Healthcare.

The Offering

Three moves, full-funnel impact

One connected motion, run in three moves: plan the audience, activate every channel, measure to the fill & refill. It sits on top of the stack you already run, not in place of it.

01 · Plan

Plan the audience

Build prescriber and patient audiences together on the deepest first-party clinical foundation in healthcare. No cookies, no modeled guesses.

02 · Activate

Activate every channel

Every channel and format snaps in as a module on one spine. Prescriber and patient journey stay in sync across every channel.

03 · Measure

Measure to the fill & refill

A closed loop that ends where revenue actually starts: the prescription filled, measured against a matched control.
